events.label: Brookings data center employment effects findings

slots.name: data processing increase
slots.sentence: Labor markets that receive their first large data center see employment rise in the data processing sector by 56% over the first decade of operations.

slots.name: telecommunications increase
slots.sentence: Telecommunications, a key sector in data center operations, jumps 43%.

slots.name: home price increase
slots.sentence: Wages are unaffected by data center builds while home prices rise 2%-5%.

slots.name: treated county jobs
slots.sentence: At a typical treated county, these estimates imply roughly 100-200 jobs, depending on facility type.

slots.name: facility sample size
slots.sentence: we assembled a dataset of approximately 1,500 U.S. data center facilities along with 52 announced-but-canceled projects and we linked these to county-level employment and wage data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (2003-2024).

slots.name: electricity rate increase
slots.sentence: Residential electricity rates nationally rose about 32% between July 2020 and July 2025.

slots.name: Virginia tax cost
slots.sentence: In Virginia alone, the data-center sales-tax exemption cost an estimated $1.6 billion in fiscal year 2025.

slots.name: hyperscale incentive share
slots.sentence: In hyperscale counties, incentives represent about 2% of total construction investment.

slots.name: colocation incentive share
slots.sentence: In colocation counties, incentives represent a much larger share of total investment (62%),
